The people between the application and the first load

Recruiting is personal.
So is our approach.

Nexus Driver Solutions connects CDL-A drivers with carriers across the United States. We bring the driver's experience and priorities together with the carrier's routes and hiring requirements.

From the first conversation through application follow-up and orientation coordination, our team helps both sides understand what comes next.
